title: Among molecules containing calcium, compute the percentage of carbon atoms
question: Among molecules containing calcium, compute the percentage of carbon atoms relative to all atoms in those molecules that also have at least one double bond.

prediction.sql:

  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'c' THEN a.XCL_001 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 /
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.XCL_001) AS percentage
FROM atom AS a
INNER JOIN molecule AS m
  ON a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010
WHERE m.XCL_010 IN (
  SELECT DISTINCT a2.XCL_002
  FROM atom AS a2
  WHERE a2.XCL_003 = 'ca'
)
  AND m.XCL_010 IN (
  SELECT DISTINCT b.XCL_005
  FROM bond AS b
  WHERE b.XCL_006 = '='
)
